deadline.value: The graduate school's fall application deadline is December 15; some departments set earlier dates.

also.quote: Some departments have earlier deadlines and/or only admit for certain terms!

supervisor.value: Faculty advise only within their own specialization; the page does not say a faculty agreement is needed before admission.
supervisor.quote: individual faculty members will only advise students within their particular area of specialization

funding.value: Support comes from individual faculty grants or other sources; the page does not say most students are funded.
funding.quote: Financial support for students is provided by individual faculty members through their research grants or other funding sources

entry_route.value: Applicants may hold an undergraduate or a master's degree in geography or a related field.
entry_route.quote: Have an undergraduate or master's degree in geography or a related field

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Two specializations: Geography (catalog poid 15333) and Remote Sensing (poid 15332). Admission is described as competitive and limited by faculty funding and personnel.
